findings.description: loadHotelSettings catches errors but doesn't inform the user. If the backend endpoint doesn't exist or returns 404/500, the form shows empty fields with no warning. Add an alert or toast notification when the load fails so admins know the feature is unavailable.

The form references ~15 new translation keys (hotel_name, hotel_email, front_desk_hours, etc.) that don't exist in the language store. The languageStore.t() calls fall back to English defaults, but this breaks localization for Amharic users. Add these keys to the translation files.

hotelSettings fields default to empty strings, but some backends expect null for unset values. If the backend validates or normalizes these fields, sending `phone: ""` instead of `phone: null` could cause validation errors. Verify backend expectations or adjust defaults.
